text: Can we add a few product categories on the catalogue page so customers can find things more easily?
I was thinking of adding a wishlist button so customers can save products and come back to them later.
When someone adds two items to the cart, they should be able to increase or decrease the quantity before placing the order.
For customer login, can we send an OTP to their mobile number instead of asking them to create a password?
Please make sure customers can complete their checkout using UPI and see a confirmation once the payment goes through.
I saw the home screen design. Can we try a different arrangement for the banners and buttons? I'll send you one combined list of changes.
It would be useful if the admin panel could show a summary of daily sales and the best-selling products. Can we include that?
Customers should be able to open their orders and check whether each one is confirmed, packed or delivered.
Can we send order updates directly to customers through WhatsApp messages as well?
We have hundreds of products. Can you add an option to upload all their details together using an Excel file?
Can we also notify customers whenever we launch a sale or have special discounts? It might help bring them back to the app.
Some customers prefer cards. Could we also provide credit and debit card payment options during checkout?
On each product page, please show the product description and its price clearly along with the other details.
Can customers see the current status of their orders whenever they open the tracking screen?
A lot of our customers are more comfortable with Hindi. Can we make the entire app available in Hindi too?
Can we create separate admin logins for our store manager and other staff, with different permissions for each person?
After seeing the updated screens, I would like to change the overall look of the app. Can we start with a completely different design direction?
Could we introduce a loyalty points system where customers earn points on every purchase and redeem them later?
Can customers filter the product catalogue by category so they can quickly find the type of item they want?
Can our staff update stock quantities from the admin panel and get an alert when a product is running low?
